passages.text: Then the LORD said to Moses, “See, I have called by name Bezalel son of Uri, the son of Hur, of the tribe of Judah.
passages.sermon:
The LORD spoke to Moses.
The LORD said these words to Moses.
The LORD said, “See, I have chosen a man.
His name is Bezalel.
Bezalel is the son of Uri.
Uri is the son of Hur.
Bezalel is from the tribe of Judah.”
passages.original: וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹֽר׃ רְאֵ֖ה קָרָ֣אתִֽי בְשֵׁ֑ם בְּצַלְאֵ֛ל בֶּן־ אוּרִ֥י בֶן־ ח֖וּר לְמַטֵּ֥ה יְהוּדָֽה׃

passages.text: And I have filled him with the Spirit of God, with skill, ability, and knowledge in all kinds of craftsmanship, to design artistic works in gold, silver, and bronze, to cut gemstones for settings, and to carve wood, so that he may be a master of every craft.
passages.sermon:
God chose Bezalel son of Uri, the son of Hur, from the tribe of Judah.
God filled Bezalel with the Spirit of God.
God gave Bezalel wisdom.
God gave Bezalel understanding.
God gave Bezalel knowledge.
God gave Bezalel skill in every kind of work.
Bezalel can make artistic designs.
Bezalel can work with gold.
Bezalel can work with silver.
Bezalel can work with bronze.
Bezalel can cut stones for setting.
Bezalel can carve wood.
Bezalel can do every kind of craft.
passages.original: וָאֲמַלֵּ֥א אֹת֖וֹ ר֣וּחַ אֱלֹהִ֑ים בְּחָכְמָ֛ה וּבִתְבוּנָ֥ה וּבְדַ֖עַת וּבְכָל־ מְלָאכָֽה׃ לַחְשֹׁ֖ב מַחֲשָׁבֹ֑ת לַעֲשׂ֛וֹת בַּזָּהָ֥ב וּבַכֶּ֖סֶף וּבַנְּחֹֽשֶׁת׃ וּבַחֲרֹ֥שֶׁת אֶ֛בֶן לְמַלֹּ֖את וּבַחֲרֹ֣שֶׁת עֵ֑ץ לַעֲשׂ֖וֹת בְּכָל־ מְלָאכָֽה׃

passages.text: Moreover, I have selected Oholiab son of Ahisamach, of the tribe of Dan, as his assistant. I have also given skill to all the craftsmen, that they may fashion all that I have commanded you: the Tent of Meeting, the ark of the Testimony and the mercy seat upon it, and all the other furnishings of the tent— the table with its utensils, the pure gold lampstand with all its utensils, the altar of incense, the altar of burnt offering with all its utensils, and the basin with its stand— as well as the woven garments, both the holy garments for Aaron the priest and the garments for his sons to serve as priests, in addition to the anointing oil and fragrant incense for the Holy Place. They are to make them according to all that I have commanded you.”
passages.sermon:
God spoke to Moses.
God chose Oholiab son of Ahisamach.
Oholiab is from the tribe of Dan.
God gave Oholiab to help Bezalel.
God gave wisdom to all skilled workers.
God gave them skill to do the work.
They will make everything God commanded Moses.
They will make the Tent of Meeting.
They will make the ark of the Testimony.
They will make the mercy seat that is on the ark.
They will make all the furnishings of the tent.
They will make the table and all its utensils.
They will make the pure gold lampstand and all its utensils.
They will make the altar of incense.
They will make the altar of burnt offering and all its utensils.
They will make the basin and its stand.
They will make the woven garments.
They will make the holy garments for Aaron the priest.
They will make the garments for Aaron’s sons to serve as priests.
They will make the anointing oil.
They will make the fragrant incense for the Holy Place.
They must make everything as God commanded Moses.
passages.original: וַאֲנִ֞י הִנֵּ֧ה נָתַ֣תִּי אִתּ֗וֹ אֵ֣ת אָהֳלִיאָ֞ב בֶּן־ אֲחִֽיסָמָךְ֙ לְמַטֵּה־ דָ֔ן וּבְלֵ֥ב כָּל־ חֲכַם־ לֵ֖ב נָתַ֣תִּי חָכְמָ֑ה וְעָשׂ֕וּ אֵ֖ת כָּל־ אֲשֶׁ֥ר צִוִּיתִֽךָ׃ אֵ֣ת׀ אֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֗ד וְאֶת־ הָֽאָרֹן֙ לָֽעֵדֻ֔ת וְאֶת־ הַכַּפֹּ֖רֶת אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָלָ֑יו וְאֵ֖ת כָּל־ כְּלֵ֥י הָאֹֽהֶל׃ וְאֶת־ הַשֻּׁלְחָן֙ וְאֶת־ כֵּלָ֔יו וְאֶת־ הַמְּנֹרָ֥ה הַטְּהֹרָ֖ה וְאֶת־ כָּל־ כֵּלֶ֑יהָ וְאֵ֖ת מִזְבַּ֥ח הַקְּטֹֽרֶת׃ וְאֶת־ מִזְבַּ֥ח הָעֹלָ֖ה וְאֶת־ כָּל־ כֵּלָ֑יו וְאֶת־ הַכִּיּ֖וֹר וְאֶת־ כַּנּֽוֹ׃ וְאֵ֖ת בִּגְדֵ֣י הַשְּׂרָ֑ד וְאֶת־ בִּגְדֵ֤י הַקֹּ֙דֶשׁ֙ לְאַהֲרֹ֣ן הַכֹּהֵ֔ן וְאֶת־ בִּגְדֵ֥י בָנָ֖יו לְכַהֵֽן׃ וְאֵ֨ת שֶׁ֧מֶן הַמִּשְׁחָ֛ה וְאֶת־ קְטֹ֥רֶת הַסַּמִּ֖ים לַקֹּ֑דֶשׁ כְּכֹ֥ל אֲשֶׁר־ צִוִּיתִ֖ךָ יַעֲשֽׂוּ׃פ

passages.text: And the LORD said to Moses, “Tell the Israelites, ‘Surely you must keep My Sabbaths, for this will be a sign between Me and you for the generations to come, so that you may know that I am the LORD who sanctifies you.
passages.sermon:
The LORD spoke to Moses.
The LORD gave Moses a command.
The LORD told Moses to speak to the Israelites.
The LORD said, “You must keep My Sabbaths.
The Sabbaths are My days of rest.
The Sabbaths are a sign between Me and you.
This sign will last for all your generations.
This sign will show that I am the LORD.
I am the LORD who makes you holy.
passages.original: וַיֹּ֥אמֶר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹֽר׃ וְאַתָּ֞ה דַּבֵּ֨ר אֶל־ בְּנֵ֤י יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר אַ֥ךְ אֶת־ שַׁבְּתֹתַ֖י תִּשְׁמֹ֑רוּ כִּי֩ א֨וֹת הִ֜וא בֵּינִ֤י וּבֵֽינֵיכֶם֙ לְדֹרֹ֣תֵיכֶ֔ם לָדַ֕עַת כִּ֛י אֲנִ֥י יְהוָ֖ה מְקַדִּשְׁכֶֽם׃

passages.text: Keep the Sabbath, for it is holy to you. Anyone who profanes it must surely be put to death. Whoever does any work on that day must be cut off from among his people.
passages.sermon:
God spoke to the Israelites through Moses.
God commanded the Israelites to keep the Sabbath.
The Sabbath is holy to the Israelites.
Anyone who profanes the Sabbath must be put to death.
Anyone who does work on the Sabbath must be cut off from his people.
passages.original: וּשְׁמַרְתֶּם֙ אֶת־ הַשַּׁבָּ֔ת כִּ֛י קֹ֥דֶשׁ הִ֖וא לָכֶ֑ם מְחַֽלְלֶ֙יהָ֙ מ֣וֹת יוּמָ֔ת כִּ֗י כָּל־ הָעֹשֶׂ֥ה בָהּ֙ מְלָאכָ֔ה וְנִכְרְתָ֛ה הַנֶּ֥פֶשׁ הַהִ֖וא מִקֶּ֥רֶב עַמֶּֽיהָ׃

passages.text: For six days work may be done, but the seventh day is a Sabbath of complete rest, holy to the LORD. Whoever does any work on the Sabbath day must surely be put to death.
passages.sermon:
God spoke to Moses on Mount Sinai.
God gave instructions to the Israelites.
God said, “You may do work for six days.
The seventh day is different.
The seventh day is a Sabbath.
The Sabbath is a day of complete rest.
The Sabbath is holy to the LORD.
Anyone who does work on the Sabbath day must be put to death.”
passages.original: שֵׁ֣שֶׁת יָמִים֮ יֵעָשֶׂ֣ה מְלָאכָה֒ וּבַיּ֣וֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִ֗י שַׁבַּ֧ת שַׁבָּת֛וֹן קֹ֖דֶשׁ לַיהוָ֑ה כָּל־ הָעֹשֶׂ֧ה מְלָאכָ֛ה בְּי֥וֹם הַשַּׁבָּ֖ת מ֥וֹת יוּמָֽת׃

passages.text: The Israelites must keep the Sabbath, celebrating it as a permanent covenant for the generations to come.
passages.sermon:
The Israelites must keep the Sabbath.
God commands the Israelites to observe the Sabbath.
The Sabbath is a special day for the Israelites.
The Israelites must celebrate the Sabbath every generation.
The Sabbath is a permanent covenant between God and the Israelites.
passages.original: וְשָׁמְר֥וּ בְנֵֽי־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל אֶת־ הַשַּׁבָּ֑ת לַעֲשׂ֧וֹת אֶת־ הַשַּׁבָּ֛ת לְדֹרֹתָ֖ם בְּרִ֥ית עוֹלָֽם׃

passages.text: It is a sign between Me and the Israelites forever; for in six days the LORD made the heavens and the earth, but on the seventh day He rested and was refreshed.’ ”
passages.sermon:
The LORD is God.
The LORD made a covenant with the Israelites.
This covenant is a sign between the LORD and the Israelites.
This sign will last forever.
The LORD created the heavens and the earth in six days.
On the seventh day, the LORD rested.
On the seventh day, the LORD was refreshed.
passages.original: בֵּינִ֗י וּבֵין֙ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל א֥וֹת הִ֖וא לְעֹלָ֑ם כִּי־ שֵׁ֣שֶׁת יָמִ֗ים עָשָׂ֤ה יְהוָה֙ אֶת־ הַשָּׁמַ֣יִם וְאֶת־ הָאָ֔רֶץ וּבַיּוֹם֙ הַשְּׁבִיעִ֔י שָׁבַ֖ת וַיִּנָּפַֽשׁ׃ס

passages.text: When the LORD had finished speaking with Moses on Mount Sinai, He gave him the two tablets of the Testimony, tablets of stone inscribed by the finger of God.
passages.sermon:
The LORD spoke with Moses on Mount Sinai.
The LORD finished speaking with Moses.
The LORD gave Moses two tablets.
These tablets are called the tablets of the Testimony.
The tablets are made of stone.
God Himself inscribed the tablets.
God used His own finger to write on the tablets.
passages.original: וַיִּתֵּ֣ן אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֗ה כְּכַלֹּתוֹ֙ לְדַבֵּ֤ר אִתּוֹ֙ בְּהַ֣ר סִינַ֔י שְׁנֵ֖י לֻחֹ֣ת הָעֵדֻ֑ת לֻחֹ֣ת אֶ֔בֶן כְּתֻבִ֖ים בְּאֶצְבַּ֥ע אֱלֹהִֽים׃
